description: Twenty original-fiction episodes interleaved with the preexisting twenty thematic actual plays: ten remote-facility/survival pairs and ten Sith-ruins/Force-mystery pairs. The separately published later bonus feed remains unchanged.
publication: Adds only original publisher-hosted fiction audio, without rehosting, mirroring or generating copyrighted works. Not official Star Wars stories.
source_policy: Use original RSS/iTunes metadata and strict series+chapter evidence. Never select trailers, discussion, highlights, book excerpts without publishing authorization, prelude recaps, or story episodes without confirmed enclosure.

sources.title: DERELICT — FATHOM
sources.focus: Secret archaeological laboratory built around an ancient alien artifact; ethical conflicts, structural failures and environmental systems.

sources.title: The Deca Tapes
sources.focus: Captives in a controlled enclosure, changing loyalties, hidden procedures and institutional secrets.

sources.title: The Orphans
sources.focus: Castaways on a hostile world, emergent artificial intelligence and character-driven survival.

sources.title: Station 151
sources.focus: A remote station, its equipment and the personal consequences of isolation.

sources.title: Among the Stars and Bones
sources.focus: Field archaeologists examining an ancient site and the evidence left by vanished inhabitants.

sources.title: Legacy: A Star Wars Audio Drama
sources.focus: Old Republic Sith/Jedi traditions, divided loyalties, family relationships and the consequences of forbidden power.

sources.title: Star Wars: Crusade of the Rebellion
sources.focus: A secret Imperial project pursuing ancient artifacts; conspiracies, domination and the cost of dangerous relics.

source_context: Exactly twenty source-verified story chapters paired before twenty preexisting tabletop plays, ten per theme. Old 70 and independently built extra twenty bonus episodes remain intact; no private campaign identifiers in public source.
